rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Pick the areas to protect. Each one gets its own step next.

room.title: Room: {room}
room.description: Pre-filled from the areas of your entities and devices; check it. Occupancy strength comes from the device class (occupancy and presence are strong, motion medium, sound weak, Bayesian sensors strong) and can be changed later in Configure. An occupancy source with 'person' in its name counts as camera person detection. {remaining} room(s) to go.

data.interior_doors: Fridge, cabinet, drawer and closet contacts
data.deter_lights_additional: More deter lights or switches (any entity)

house.title: Whole house
house.description: Each resident's device trackers and user are read from their person entity, and re-read when it changes.

data.extra_trackers: More device trackers that mean someone is home
data.automated_loads: Power sensors of loads that run on their own (EV charger, heat pump)
data.lcm_events: Lock Code Manager 'credential used' event entities

csi_map.title: Wi-Fi motion sensors and doors
csi_map.description: For each Wi-Fi motion sensor, pick the contact on the same door. Motion there with no door opening within 60 seconds scores door_csi_motion.

house_deter.title: Trust, night and deterrence
house_deter.description: Changes made by trusted users or by automations never score. Residents and a user named Presence Simulation are pre-selected. Voice assistants through Home Assistant Cloud act as the Home Assistant Cloud user.

data.deter_sound: Deter sound (media URL or media-source id)
data.deter_tts_entity: Deter text-to-speech entity (used instead of the sound)

responses.title: Responses
responses.description: SIEM never sends notifications or changes your alarm panel. Every alert fires a siem_notification event, and your own automations decide what to do with it (see the sample packages). Dry run stays on until you turn it off: deterrence is only described, and every alert is marked [DRY RUN] with the actions that would have run.

data.ai_task_entity: AI task entity for the digest
data.digest_post_when_empty: Send the digest when nothing happened
data.dry_run: Dry run (describe actions instead of running them)
data.auto_alarm: Auto alarm (pulse the alarm trigger sensor at the alarm tier)

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one SIEM instance is supported.

menu_options.rooms: Add or remove rooms (re-runs every room step)

data.entry_then_occupied: Chain: entry, then someone in a room
data.occupied_then_activity: Chain: someone in a room, then a light, appliance or interior door

no_incident.message: There is no incident with that id.

label_incident.name: Label incident
label_incident.description: Label an incident. False alarm lowers the weights of its rules by 10% (to no less than 0.3) and real raises them by 10% (to no more than 1.5); that's me and guest are recorded and leave the weights alone.

label.name: Label
label.description: False alarm, that's me, guest or real.

incident_id.name: Incident id
incident_id.description: Defaults to the open or most recent incident.

run_digest.name: Run digest
run_digest.description: Send the digest for everything since the previous one.

set_house_mode.name: Set house mode
set_house_mode.description: Force a house mode, or auto to derive it again. A forced mode survives restarts.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Auto, vacant, guest, service or family.
